name: windows-wsl-coordination
description: Coordinate between Windows and WSL environments. Manage .wslconfig for resource allocation, WSL distribution management, cross-platform file access paths, and handoff protocols between WinAdmin and WSL Admin roles. Use when: configuring WSL resources, managing WSL distributions, accessing files across Windows/WSL boundaries, coordinating Windows and Linux admin tasks, or troubleshooting WSL memory, mount not found, permission denied issues.
